review_evidence: Independently read the fresh anti-anchored reviewer packet, its current Lean module, blind reconstruction, lesson, formula proof, assumptions and obligation binding; compared with arXiv:2605.07006v1 Section 4.1, Lemma 4.2 and the Section 1 oracle and regularity conventions. No canonical registry, previous review verdict, audit, or repair was consulted. This is source/semantic review, not an independent build or VERIFIED transition.

objects.original: Original objective, center, minimizers and quadratic regularization within an algorithmic reduction.
objects.reconstructed: The same objective and quadratic; an original global minimizer z is supplied and a regularized global minimizer w is constructed.
objects.evidence: Lemma 4.2 proof names both minimizers. The packet defines W from f and proves its actual global minimum, so the witness is not an unrelated objective or oracle.

domains.original: Euclidean space and a real objective.
domains.reconstructed: Any proper normed additive commutative group and a continuous real objective.
domains.evidence: Finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces satisfy properness. The compact-ball argument in the current module needs no scalar multiplication on E; the broader domain is disclosed in the lesson and candidate assumptions.

quantifiers.original: A uniform solver reduction; for the chosen function and initial point, compare the regularized solution with an original minimizer.
quantifiers.reconstructed: For each admissible f,z,x0,R,epsilon, one w is chosen before a universal implication over all x.
quantifiers.evidence: The existential w precedes the all-x implication, preserving the shared minimizer and radius witness. No solver or class-wide quantifier is claimed by the binding.

assumptions.original: Convex smooth objective with an attained minimum and initial radius certificate; positive accuracy in the regularization regime.
assumptions.reconstructed: Continuity, properness, a supplied global original minimizer, R>0, epsilon>0 and the same radius certificate.
assumptions.evidence: Smoothness supplies continuity in the source domain. Convexity and differentiability are unnecessary for this comparison. Positivity is explicitly recorded and used to cancel epsilon/R²; no W-minimizer is assumed.

conclusion.original: The full lemma gives an explicit first-order algorithm and a query bound; its proof transfers radius and half-error accuracy.
conclusion.reconstructed: Existence of W-minimizer, sharp radius comparison and uniform half-error-to-full-error implication.
conclusion.evidence: The current binding supports only regularized-minimum, radius-comparison and accuracy-transfer. These are precisely the module conclusion and lesson; curvature and oracle-cost-class are separate obligations.

scopes.original: Unconstrained global optimization in the positive regularization part of Lemma 4.2.
scopes.reconstructed: Global minimization on Set.univ; all x in E; the same W and w throughout.
scopes.evidence: Compact-ball minimization is upgraded to global minimality using f(z)<=f(x) and the outside-ball penalty comparison. The lesson does not confuse the intermediate compact domain with the final domain.

constant_dependencies.original: Regularization epsilon/R², regularized tolerance epsilon/2 and final tolerance epsilon; full complexity also depends on beta and phi.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Exactly these regularization and error constants, with radius bound no larger than the original minimizer radius.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Positive R justifies division and delta R²/2=epsilon/2. The theorem does not use beta, phi or a condition-number inequality; publication labels the complexity formula as remaining work.
